description:
Configure a new 'Wholesale' order type in Drupal Commerce to support B2B sales. 

1. Create a new Order Type named 'Wholesale' that uses the 'Fulfillment' workflow (not the default).
2. Create a new Order Item Type named 'Wholesale Product' that allows purchasing 'Product variation' entities, and assign it to your new 'Wholesale' order type.
3. Finally, create a new draft order for the existing customer 'mikewilson'. Set the order type to 'Wholesale' and add at least one product (any available product) to the order.

Note: You do not need to check out or complete payment, just save the order with items.
